The nine groups into which the letters are divided are the

The 16 vowels are divided (v. 4) .

seven groups of five each.

the number

different

of letters

obtained is 576 (= 16 >< 36).
‘This is the complete number of
letters, the complete number of Yantras and of years (i. e. they.
represent a cycle).

Kalpa and other periods of time.
Multipled by 3,000 we get}
the duration of Kyzta-yuga (Satya Yuga).
That is, 1,728,000
years is the duration of Satya Yuga,
Three-fourths of this
period (1,296,009) is the duration of Treté Yuga.
Half of the’
duration of Satya (864,000) is the duration of Dvipara and a
fourth of it (432,000) is the duration of Kali Yuga.

Shiva says: “Whatever the two lettersin the word Kala signify
that is My Body.
I cannot easily describe or show it to Thee,
but will try to do so by illustration. Day succeeds night because
of the movements by rotation of the sun, the moon and the other
heavenly bodies.
Therefore it is not right to speak of Time
(Kala) as identical with night and day (Tan-mayat4-rdpam).
Lava, Tru/i and other divisions of time are merely fractions of

universal Time.

The

one

nature (Ripa)

of Kala is that Chit

which has neither beginning nor end.
Lava, Trudi and the
like are merely
measures
of (Anumiyate) Kala.
That is
the true nature (Svaripa) of Kala, which is gained or known
(Yat tu labhyate) by meditating thereon (BhAvanit) according
to the capacity of one’s intelligence (Svabuddhya)
Nothing
more can be said about this.”
